## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run package` succeeds.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or generated build artifacts are committed.
